charaepi_ch0098_90_hau/2301_1101_100_20:
Hau invited [Name:PlayerNickname ] and
Calem on a pancake restaurant tour.
charaepi_ch0098_90_hau/2301_1201_100_10: Those places’ pancakes were next level!
charaepi_ch0098_90_hau/2301_1201_200_10:
Whenever I have time, I like to stop in at
restaurants with Raichu and the gang!
charaepi_ch0098_90_hau/2301_1201_300_10: We’ve had lots of yummy meals together!
charaepi_ch0098_90_hau/2301_1201_400_10:
Do you know any other good places to get
pancakes, Calem?
charaepi_ch0098_90_hau/2301_1201_500_10:
Hmm... Serena or Shauna would probably
know better than me.
charaepi_ch0098_90_hau/2301_1201_600_10:
But I do like going to cafés with my
Pokémon...
charaepi_ch0098_90_hau/2301_1201_700_10:
so I get why you’d want to try more
restaurants, Hau!
charaepi_ch0098_90_hau/2301_1201_900_10:
Do you have a favorite restaurant,
[Name:PlayerNickname ]?
charaepi_ch0098_90_hau/2301_1201_1000_10: If you do, we should do this again sometime!
charaepi_ch0098_90_hau/2301_1201_1100_10:
I love walking around discovering food with
everyone!
charaepi_ch0098_90_hau/2301_1201_1200_10:
We really bonded over all those restaurants’
pancakes and malasadas!
charaepi_ch0098_90_hau/2301_1201_1300_10: That’s probably why I awakened my arc suit!
charaepi_ch0098_90_hau/2301_1201_1500_10:
You know, compared to when we first came
to Pasio...
charaepi_ch0098_90_hau/2301_1201_1600_10: I feel like our teamwork has improved!
charaepi_ch0098_90_hau/2301_1201_1700_10:
I wanna keep having lots of meals and
battles with everyone!
charaepi_ch0098_90_hau/2301_0301_100_10: You haven’t changed a bit, Hau!
charaepi_ch0098_90_hau/2301_0401_100_10: You bet! I’m me, after all!
charaepi_ch0098_90_hau/2301_0302_100_10: You always seem to be having fun!
charaepi_ch0098_90_hau/2301_0402_100_10: Heh heh, yeah... I get that a lot!
charaepi_ch0098_90_hau/2301_1201_1800_10:
There were times in Alola when I felt kinda
directionless...
charaepi_ch0098_90_hau/2301_1201_1900_10:
but at the end of the day, my heart’s always
in the same place!
charaepi_ch0098_90_hau/2301_1201_2000_10: I just try to go all out and enjoy everything!
charaepi_ch0098_90_hau/2301_1201_2100_10:
That’s the most important thing a Trainer
can do, really.
charaepi_ch0098_90_hau/2301_1201_2200_10:
Your ability to maintain that mindset is what
makes you strong, Hau.
charaepi_ch0098_90_hau/2301_1201_2300_10:
All right! We’ve eaten our fill, so...wanna
have a battle?
charaepi_ch0098_90_hau/2301_1201_2600_10:
If the two of you win, I’ll treat you to some
of that restaurant’s pancakes!
charaepi_ch0098_90_hau/2301_1201_2700_10:
Let’s go, Raichu! We’re gonna enjoy this with
full power!
